purpose: Challenge the selected cross-session amount-clock persistence mechanism against all nearby frozen families before any Campaign056 source partition or value is read.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_day_over_day_amount_profile_similarity_240b
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: High repetition of a stock's normalized 240-bin CNY activity clock on consecutive accepted sessions may indicate a multi-session execution program whose participation persists into a three-session holding horizon.
selected_mechanism.formula: Normalize the exact 240 continuous-auction amounts for the signal session and immediately preceding accepted market session separately, compute their equal-mixture natural-log Jensen-Shannon divergence, and return 1-JSD/ln(2).
selected_mechanism.previous_session_definition: immediately preceding accepted local market-calendar session; never previous observed stock day across a suspension or missing session

overlap_challenges.reason: Campaign049 compares two 120-bin halves inside one date. Campaign056 concatenates the full 240-bin clock and compares consecutive dates; holding either date's morning-versus-afternoon relation fixed while permuting clock mass across the other date can change Campaign056 alone.

Entropy summarizes one date's unordered amount concentration. Two dates may have identical entropy and disjoint clock locations, producing low Campaign056 similarity, or different entropies with partially aligned profiles.
The terminal persistence factor correlates adjacent amount changes within one session. Campaign056 uses no within-day lag and compares matching absolute clock bins across two sessions.

Late share, opening share, center of mass, and daily turnover summarize level or coarse timing on one date. Campaign056 requires the complete matched-bin shape and is exactly invariant to multiplying either session's entire amount vector by any positive scalar.
Market synchronization compares one stock with a same-date leave-one-out peer activity profile. Campaign056 uses no peer state and compares the stock only with its own previous accepted session.

Campaign045, Campaign053, price-impact, range-volume, VWAP, and update-clock families require price, return, range, volume, or equality information. Campaign056 reads amount only and is unchanged when every price field changes with both amount profiles fixed.

Candidate49 counts ordered close crossings around a causal same-session cumulative VWAP and requires close plus volume. Campaign056 constructs no price anchor or crossing, reads no close or volume, and remains historical-only without Candidate49 backfill.
Campaign056 computes one raw two-session amount statistic. It loads no terminal factor value and contains no fitted weight, regime, filter, threshold, subset, combination, or model.

decision.next_action: Freeze one exact coverage-first 79-comparison no-return protocol, with one conditional development trial only if admitted, before implementing or reading Campaign056 source values.
